stem: 以下关于通风报信的陈述,哪一项是正确的？

options.A: 禁止通风报信的义务仅适用于AFC专业人士和银行工作人员,因为他们需要提交可疑活动报告(SAR).
options.B: 通风报信是指未经授权向可能成为调查对象或可能妨碍调查的第三方披露有关金融犯罪调查的机密信息的犯罪行为.
options.C: 当对交易监控系统已标记的客户进行详细询问时,不构成通风报信.
options.D: 当发现异常交易时,反洗钱专员可以指示客户经理与客户沟通,以决定是否应提交可疑交易报告.

stem_en: Which of the following statements is true regarding tipping off?

options_en.A: The tipping-off obligation is only applied to AFC professionals and bank staff because they are required to file a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR)
options_en.B: Tipping off is a criminal act whereby confidential information about a financial crime investigation is disclosed in an unauthorized manner to a third party who may be the subject of the investigation or able to prejudice it
options_en.C: Tipping off is not committed when detailed inquiries are made with a customer whose transactions have been flagged by a transaction monitoring system
options_en.D: When unusual transactions are identified, the AML specialist can instruct the relationship manager to communicate with the customer to decide whether a suspicious transaction report should be filed
